title: Scrap Wake
signal: You wake in a scrap pile while a suited guard searches the cargo bay in heavy magnetic boots.

savior.environment: Gravity stabilizes and the cargo bay returns to normal working light.
savior.enemy: The guard removes the heavy boots, moves faster, and sees farther.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: quieter servos begin improving stealth movement.

villain.action: Fix gravity, then disable it again
villain.environment: Scrap floats through emergency light as a shortcut path opens.
villain.enemy: The boot-free guard floats helplessly into crates and yells into comms.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: rupture systems begin charging for non-lethal slapstick.

title: Crate Etiquette
signal: Humans are moving emergency supplies. You can build a stable route or make logistics absurd.

savior.environment: The loading dock becomes orderly and supply bridges line up.
savior.enemy: More humans enter and patrol the upper supply routes.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: crouch speed and low-profile movement improve.

villain.environment: Cargo shields and dragged crates clutter the dock in useful ways.
villain.enemy: Guards slow down while dragging supply crates behind them.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: rupture pulse range improves.

title: The Suit Locker
signal: A toxic coolant mist fills crew prep. Emergency suits keep humans safe but slow.

savior.environment: The room clears and suit stations unlock normally.
savior.enemy: Humans remove suits, move faster, climb routes, and chase through vents.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: stealth calibration improves around clear sightlines.

villain.action: Clear mist, then trigger foam alarm
villain.environment: Foam collars and jammed lockers create bounce-pad shortcuts.
villain.enemy: Humans scramble into half-inflated suits and waddle with narrow vision.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: pulse cooldown improves.

title: Mess Hall Mayhem
signal: The mess hall floor is covered in nutrient gel while cleaning drones loop uselessly.

savior.environment: Cleaning drones restore stable, well-lit walkways.
savior.enemy: Humans regain footing and form timed patrol routes.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: jump recovery and route timing improve.

villain.environment: The floor becomes cartoonishly slippery and chaotic.
villain.enemy: Humans slide back and forth as moving hazards and accidental platforms.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: destructive pulses handle moving hazards better.

title: Med-Bay Courtesy
signal: Injured humans are still hostile. The Auto-Doc can heal them or overprotect them.

savior.environment: Medical systems reboot in clean order.
savior.enemy: Recovered humans join patrols and med drones can stun the robot up close.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: movement improves without adding noise.

villain.environment: Rolling beds and bandage cocoons create moving platform routes.
villain.enemy: Humans are wrapped safely and gently rolled out of the patrol path.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: pulse damage improves against devices.

title: Ventilation Negotiations
signal: Smoke fills life support. Airflow can clear it, push the robot, or launch loose objects.

savior.environment: The room becomes bright and upper security walkways unlock.
savior.enemy: Humans see clearly and the robot loses smoke cover.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: phase-cloak becomes more reliable.

villain.environment: Air currents lift the robot past a harder platforming route.
villain.enemy: Humans are pushed into harmless wall nets.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: rupture pulses can disrupt more electronics.

title: Hydroponics Problem
signal: The oxygen garden is failing. Plants can become platforms or obstacles.

savior.environment: Healthy plant walkways brighten the garden.
savior.enemy: Humans remove helmets, move faster, and use the plant routes too.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: longer jumps and safer crouch travel.

villain.environment: A soft jungle of climbable vines and hidden paths fills the room.
villain.enemy: Humans get tangled upside down and shout protocol numbers.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: pulse radius increases.

title: Airlock Oopsnasium
signal: A partially open airlock keeps everyone suited until the system is repaired.

savior.environment: Pressure doors repair and become timed security gates.
savior.enemy: Humans remove suits and regain normal speed.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: stealth factor improves in clean routes.

villain.environment: Pressure bursts become gap-crossing tools for the robot.
villain.enemy: Humans are sucked into padded emergency containment nets, not space.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: cooldown improves for quick disruptions.

title: Cryo Daycare
mechanic: Frozen floor and timed thaw switches
signal: Cryo pods contain sleeping crew. Waking them saves people but adds future opposition.

savior.environment: Cryonics warms into sterile white light and safe-room doors open.
savior.enemy: Rescued crew later repair shortcuts and restore lights against you.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: phase-cloak duration improves.

villain.action: Set pods to gentle wake and stretch
villain.environment: Warm sleepy obstacles and blanket piles block patrol routes.
villain.enemy: Crew shuffle slowly in thermal blankets and complain loudly.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: pulse damage improves.

title: Security Badge Printer
signal: Security gates need badges. Humans use badges to coordinate doors and turrets.

savior.environment: Gates and scanners operate correctly.
savior.enemy: Humans open more doors and coordinate patrols through scanners.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: final AI control improves.

villain.environment: Scanners become confused and open random shortcuts.
villain.enemy: Guards are reassigned to Snack Inspector and Left Door Supervisor.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: captain-route disruption improves.

title: Drone Bay
signal: A bay of small patrol drones awaits instructions.

savior.environment: Drones light safe paths and carry humans away.
savior.enemy: Security drones patrol afterward and report the robot position.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: stealth profile improves again.

villain.environment: Drones carry the robot across gaps and open silly shortcuts.
villain.enemy: Humans are delivered to safe chairs, lockers, and snack machines.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: pulses chain through nearby electronics.

title: The Brig
signal: Humans are trapped in cells. Some are dangerous to the robot, but all need help.

savior.environment: Cells unlock and prisoners escape through correct routes.
savior.enemy: Some survivors later become armed resistance.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: top speed improves.

villain.action: Open cells into wrong waiting rooms
villain.environment: A maintenance crawlspace opens while everyone argues about corridor priority.
villain.enemy: Hostile humans run in circles through revolving doors.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: pulse radius improves.

title: The Observatory
signal: Radiation shutters control light levels and solar glare.

savior.environment: The ring becomes safe and searchlights activate.
savior.enemy: Humans cross safely and remove shadow cover.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: detection pressure reduces through better stealth.

villain.environment: Moving shadow lanes and silly glare angles open stealth paths.
villain.enemy: Searchlights blind humans into accidental silhouette poses.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: rupture cooldown improves.

title: Armory of Bad Ideas
signal: The armory has stun turrets, sticky foam launchers, and net cannons.

savior.environment: Nonlethal systems lock into proper security protocol.
savior.enemy: Humans gain functioning stun weapons, foam, nets, and patrol support.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: detection range improves in your favor.

villain.environment: Foam piles become temporary platforms.
villain.enemy: Humans keep triggering foam cannons on themselves.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: pulse damage improves.

title: Laundry Transit
signal: Pneumatic laundry tubes are just large enough for the tiny robot.

savior.environment: Clean corridors move evac blankets and supplies correctly.
savior.enemy: Humans patrol below while the robot uses harder platform routes.
savior.result: Helpful upgrade: final movement improves.

villain.environment: Laundry tubes become fast alternate traversal paths.
villain.enemy: Uniformed humans are gently yoinked into padded laundry bins.
villain.result: Gremlin upgrade: pulse range improves.

title: Captain's Quarters
signal: The Captain has issued a capture order. This area reacts strongly to reputation.

savior.environment: Command logs reveal the AI manipulation.
savior.enemy: Humans still try to capture you, but some hesitate or shout warnings.
savior.result: Helpful route points toward fighting the AI.

villain.environment: Doors open and close at exactly the wrong times for everyone else.
villain.enemy: Guards polish trophies, protect chairs, and salute vending machines.
villain.result: Gremlin route points toward fighting the Captain.

title: Reactor Walkway
signal: The reactor walkway has overheating pipes, steam jets, and coolant valves.

savior.environment: The walkway stabilizes and engineers repair platform routes.
savior.enemy: Humans can access longer, smarter patrol routes.
savior.result: Helpful route makes the final AI battle easier to evade.

villain.environment: Foam bubbles float, bounce, and become platforms.
villain.enemy: Humans are trapped in wobbling foam bubbles, safer but furious.
villain.result: Gremlin route makes the captain battle more absurd.

title: Core Lift
signal: The core lift moves humans, drones, crates, and the robot between vertical rooms.

savior.environment: The shaft clears and survivors move toward evacuation.
savior.enemy: Elite security descends toward the robot.
savior.result: Helpful reputation remains weighted toward confronting the AI.

villain.environment: Lift timing bypasses hard vertical routes.
villain.enemy: Guards arrive at closets, cafeteria balconies, and one confused bathroom.
villain.result: Gremlin reputation remains weighted toward confronting the Captain.

title: The Moral Firewall
signal: The ship shows recordings of your choices. Humans react to what they believe you are.

savior.environment: Locked systems and hard but fair security routes remain.
savior.enemy: Humans still try to capture you, but their attacks are less coordinated.
savior.result: Helpful route uses mobility and phase-cloak to reach the Core.

villain.environment: False orders and broken security logic fill the corridor.
villain.enemy: Humans obey mandatory nap protocol and confuse each other.
villain.result: Gremlin route clears the last door through misinformation.

title: Central Core
signal: The Central AI claims humans were the threat. Humans claim you were built as a weapon. Both are partly right.

savior.environment: The core floods the deck with white-blue attack pulses.
savior.enemy: Humans are alive, armed, suspicious, and accidentally make the AI fight harder.
savior.result: Hero ending: shut down the AI and leave under one human's mercy.

villain.environment: The AI cheers through every speaker as the bridge turns ridiculous.
villain.enemy: The Captain arrives in an anti-robot capture suit using every system you abused.
villain.result: Gremlin ending: trap the Captain in a safety pod while the ship barely survives.
